title: A CLI checkout whose only change is the managed AGENTS.md block is not dirty
description: Real Git fixtures: a checkout whose only change lies inside AGENTS.md's managed graphyard block passes up's dirty-checkout preflight and the loop's refusal and records a clean release; a change outside the block, or real work beside it, still stops as before (GY-3271).

steps.name: managed-block-only AGENTS.md change is not uncommitted work
